platform: Omarchy 4.5.0-3, Hyprland 0.56.2, kernel 7.2.15-4-omarchy, x86_64, Quickshell 0.3.2, Node v26.13.1
scope: 0.5.0 feature, hardening, and UI-extraction release. Extracts CommandRunner.qml (shared Process + StdioCollector wrapper) and SettingsPage.qml (in-panel settings page with draft cancellation); adds endingSoonNotify reminders, steamUseClient single-app launch with Steam bundle/package support, epicHideAddOns and epicShowUpcoming, Amazon Luna claim-slug redemption badges, inline countdowns, Shift+S mark-all-seen, y write-only clipboard link copy, read-only list and markAllSeen IPC actions, per-store exponential backoff retries, lib/seen-state empty-payload refusal, and synchronized paste completion and Escape cancellation in EntryField.qml.
install: The development symlink was unlinked (the repository untouched, git status clean) and the plugin installed from https://github.com/salmun-nister/omarchy-loot-drops with `OMARCHY_SHELL_IPC_TIMEOUT=10s omarchy plugin add ... --enable --yes`, which cloned 7ada8666d9cca9a7e71beeba2ff1bfaccd0cdc83 (VERSION 0.5.0) and preserved the user's existing bar.layout.right entry at index 18 (amazonEnabled=true, hideSeen=true, epicMobileAndroid=true, epicMobileIos=true, country='', refreshMinutes=90, epicShowUpcoming=true, endingSoonNotify=true). An earlier `add` attempt without an extended IPC timeout hit `omarchy-shell is not responding` on the default 2s `rescanPlugins` IPC wait and was retried cleanly with `OMARCHY_SHELL_IPC_TIMEOUT=10s`. The clone was checked out at v0.4.8 (34b6a75) and `omarchy restart shell` loaded 0.4.8; `omarchy plugin update salmun-nister.loot-drops --yes` then fast-forwarded back to 7ada866 (VERSION 0.5.0) with every setting preserved, and after `omarchy restart shell` the `list` IPC reported Epic (4 live + 1 upcoming) and Amazon (11). `omarchy plugin remove salmun-nister.loot-drops --yes` deleted the clone and removed its `shell.json` entry while `seen.json` remained intact. The development symlink, `shell.json` loot-drops configuration, and `seen.json` (sha256 f3ae1f57216fc87e19754da1d9066875be4ab2f3ae55e776eec3bd2a6a630221) were restored and verified with `omarchy restart shell`.
commands: git -C ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/salmun-nister.loot-drops checkout v0.4.8 && omarchy restart shell
OMARCHY_SHELL_IPC_TIMEOUT=10s omarchy plugin update salmun-nister.loot-drops --yes && omarchy restart shell
restore development symlink, shell.json loot-drops entry, and seen.json; omarchy restart shell

results.detail: ./tests/run passed scripts/check.mjs, 103/103 unit, QML-surface, and release-doc tests, real Qt qmllint on all 4 QML files (BarWidget.qml, CommandRunner.qml, EntryField.qml, SettingsPage.qml) with 0 errors, and 33 helper assertions (including empty-payload refusal in seen-state). `omarchy plugin validate .` exited 0. `validate_plugin.py --json --security .` returned valid=true, errors=[], findings=[], and outcome='review-required' (limited deterministic scan, not a security audit).

./tests/harness/run passed with 4 rendered rows (laidOut=true, settingsRows=18, gameRows=2, headers=['epic','amazon']), Epic returning 2 live games plus 1 upcoming (Strange Antiquities), and paste checks overflow=DE timeout=DE success=GB (Amazon timed out inside the harness's 12s cold-profile window and showed its retryable error state). On the running shell, `omarchy-shell salmun-nister.loot-drops list` resolved all four stores (Steam 0, Epic 4 live + 1 upcoming, GOG 0, Amazon 11 with redemption badges), `markSeen amazon test-id-050` persisted to seen.json (then restored byte-identically), and invalid `openGame` calls exited 0 without opening anything.

results.check: Fresh install, update from 0.4.8 and removal
results.detail: Installed from GitHub at 7ada866 with --enable --yes while preserving the existing bar.layout.right settings at index 18, checked out v0.4.8 and restarted the shell, updated back to 7ada866 (0.5.0) via `omarchy plugin update` and verified live IPC after `omarchy restart shell`, then removed cleanly via `omarchy plugin remove` leaving seen.json intact. Desktop symlink, shell.json, and seen.json were restored and verified.

limitations: Interactive pointer/keyboard driving of the live panel and live ending-soon desktop notifications were not triggered by hand in this run; those paths are covered by the model/QML-surface tests and live Quickshell harness. Live store results depend on active promotions: Steam and GOG had zero active giveaways during live verification, so GOG's success path remains fixture-only, and Amazon Luna was tested signed out and timed out within the harness's 12s cold-profile window (resolving all 11 games against the warm live-shell profile). A vertical bar remains untested. Scripted install/update/remove used OMARCHY_SHELL_IPC_TIMEOUT=10s after a 2s IPC ping timeout during `rescanPlugins`, and `omarchy restart shell` was needed after `omarchy plugin update` so the running shell loaded updated QML IPC handlers. Validators and baseline checks are limited deterministic scans, not a security audit.
